description: This file contains the implementation of the ReplicaCalculator for Kubernetes Pod Autoscaler, including functions to compute desired replica counts based on various metrics and resource utilization, as well as helper functions for pod and request analysis.

classes.name: Tolerances
classes.description: Contains scale-up and scale-down tolerances for metrics.

classes.name: ReplicaCalculator
classes.description: Calculates desired replica counts based on various metrics and resource utilization.

methods.name: NewReplicaCalculator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReplicaCalculator with specified metrics client, pod lister, and timing parameters.

methods.name: GetResourceReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on resource utilization percentage.

methods.name: GetRawResourceReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on raw resource usage (e.g., milli-value).

methods.name: GetMetricReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on a specific metric's usage.

methods.name: GetObjectMetricReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on object metric usage.

methods.name: getUsageRatioReplicaCount
methods.description: Helper to compute replica count from usage ratio and ready pod count.

methods.name: GetObjectPerPodMetricReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on per-pod object metric.

methods.name: GetExternalMetricReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on external metric value.

methods.name: GetExternalPerPodMetricReplicas
methods.description: Calculates desired replicas based on external metric per pod.

methods.name: groupPods
methods.description: Groups pods into ready, unready, missing, and ignored sets based on their status and metrics.

methods.name: calculateRequests
methods.description: Computes resource requests for pods, optionally for a specific container.

methods.name: calculatePodLevelRequests
methods.description: Calculates resource requests at the pod level.

methods.name: calculatePodRequestsFromContainers
methods.description: Calculates resource requests by summing container requests.

methods.name: removeMetricsForPods
methods.description: Removes metrics entries for specified pods.
